subject.title: Discord turns can be missed or finish silently across gateway restart/recovery on 2026.6.10

question: Should #98081 remain the umbrella for the v2026.6.10 Discord restart/recovery incident, or should maintainers close it after splitting the remaining inbound catch-up and durable final-delivery work into canonical issues?
rationale: Current main fixed only slices of the report, while the remaining behavior requires maintainer policy for provider-history replay, ambiguous send reconciliation, and final-delivery observability.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Track this incident until #55792-style inbound catch-up and #87561-style final-delivery semantics are resolved or explicitly linked as the remaining canonical work.

options.title: Split and close
options.body: Move the unresolved symptoms to narrower canonical issues and close #98081 only after each symptom has a clear owner and proof requirement.

options.title: Close as partial duplicate
options.body: Close this into #55792 and #87561 now, accepting that the v2026.6.10 combined restart evidence will live only in linked history.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
